hardware_and_method.baseline: NCCL default local transport with peer access within NUMA groups; NCCL_NET=Socket, NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none, NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1. This is not the --shm-only profile.
hardware_and_method.sizes: complete input bytes per rank; output is input/8
hardware_and_method.timing: Worst-rank CUDA event per invocation, median of 20 calls, median of five alternating paired repetitions. Ten warmups per backend per size. Fill/verification kernels outside the event intervals, but their host submission gaps can enter the original benchmark intervals. Boundary probe separates those gaps and synchronizes fills before start events. Nsight traces have profiler overhead and are not latency comparison controls.
hardware_and_method.validation: Every benchmark invocation checks every output element on all eight ranks; policy check: 35 passed.

build_command: make -j2 adaptive-collectives router-checks BUILD=build/rs_opt_20261113 CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.9 CUTLASS_HOME=/data/zhongjie/cutlass-v4.5.0 NCCL_HOME=build/nccl-2.28.9
performance_scope: BF16 out-of-place RS; complete input bytes/rank. One process owns all eight L4s, four per NUMA group. NCCL 2.28.9 default local transport with within-group P2P allowed. Original eager benchmark timing, including host submission gaps; no boundary-probe times mixed into these results.
repetitions: Ten warmups, five alternating paired backend repetitions, twenty output-checked calls per repetition. Per-call slowest-rank CUDA events; median of per-run medians. Confirmation orders control/batch/direct/direct/batch/control; table uses median of the two sweep medians. Min/max bound run medians, not confidence intervals.
selection: One fixed configuration per curve, no per-size best variant selection. Recommended candidate is --small-rs-workers-per-node 4 --batch-cpu-jobs. All new C++ options default off/zero; Auto requires matching exact-size calibration against the caller's fallback.
negative_results: CPU destination stripes and direct pinned results remain explicit experiments. Direct results regress at 2/4 MiB; CPU stripes do not consistently beat the recommended flat schedule in the target range. All negative timing rows retained.
validation: See correctness.json and capi_checks.json. Four-GPU 2+2 subset 0,1,4,5; eight/three-GPU and one-NUMA subsets; delayed ranks, masks, tails, in-place/out-of-place, independent numerical and guard checks, graph queue wrap and C API regression. TSAN runtime could not start because of unexpected memory mappings (both PIE and no-PIE); native host tests passed.
limits: Single-node standalone eager collective measurements. Not an eight-process drop-in or SGLang end-to-end result. Archived profiles are bound to this binary/topology/fallback; regenerate after rebuilding.
gpu_isolation: Final screening/confirmation scripts checked for other compute processes before and after every run. Earlier shared-GPU attempts are retained under contended/ and excluded from summaries and profiles.
